page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Optimized3.Flex.16-64 is a compute-focused virtual machine instance built on the x86_64 CPU architecture. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 6354 processor running at a dedicated clock speed of 3.0 GHz. The instance configuration provisions 16 physical cores and 32 vCPUs through hyperthreading, allocating two execution threads per core. System memory is sized at 64.0 GB, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio that aligns directly with compute-intensive architectural design standards.

Hardware tradeoffs for this instance include the absence of dedicated local disk storage and hardware GPU acceleration. Persistent storage and operating system images must be managed using attached remote cloud storage volumes. Network provisioning comes standard with one complimentary public IPv4 address for ingress and egress routing. Because all CPU threads are backed by dedicated physical compute resources rather than oversubscribed shared pools, processing performance remains consistent under sustained execution.

From an efficiency perspective, the high clock rate and compact memory ratio optimize cost-to-compute metrics for parallel workloads that do not demand extensive RAM pools or local caching disks. VM.Optimized3.Flex.16-64 is well suited for CPU-heavy tasks such as continuous integration and build compilation, distributed batch processing, computational simulations, backend API serving, and media encoding.
description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Optimized3.Flex.16-64 is a compute-optimized virtual machine tailored for compute-heavy enterprise applications. Driven by the x86_64 architecture, the instance incorporates an Intel Xeon 6354 processor operating at a base frequency of 3.0 GHz. The hardware configuration features 16 dedicated physical cores yielding 32 vCPUs via two threads per core, combined with 64.0 GB of system memory. This 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio ensures high processing density per gigabyte of memory, maximizing compute efficiency for parallelized processing tasks. The instance does not include integrated local disk storage or hardware accelerators, requiring external block storage for persistent data requirements. Network connectivity includes one complimentary public IPv4 address. Given its sustained clock speeds and dedicated core model, VM.Optimized3.Flex.16-64 is particularly suited for batch compute jobs, high-performance web servers, CI/CD compilation workloads, and algorithmic processing.
